news.title: Search for suspects after man beaten, carjacked in southwest Atlanta: APD
news.summary: Police are asking for the public's help to identify armed suspects accused of beating a man and stealing his car in southwest Atlanta last Friday.

news.title: Newnan police shooting review hinges on self-defense, not chase, DA says
news.summary: The criminal review into the fatal police shooting of 18-year-old Zadarious Dorsey hinges on self-defense rather than whether the officer had legal grounds to chase him, prosecutors announced.

news.title: Fentanyl, handguns found in Gwinnett home across from elementary school
